Card Q&A.a: No, even if you play 2 or more Digimon with the [Legend-Arms] trait at the same time with 1 effect, you can only gain 1 memory with this card's inherited effect.
Card Q&A.q: If I play 2 or more Digimon with the [Legend-Arms] trait at the same time, do I gain 1 memory for each Digimon played with this card's inherited effect?

Card Q&A.a: Yes, in that situation you can gain 2 memory in total.
Card Q&A.q: If I have 2 Digimon with this card in their digivolution cards, and play 1 Digimon with the [Legend-Arms] trait, can I activate both inherited effects and gain 2 memory?

Inherited Effect: [Your Turn][Once Per Turn] When you play another Digimon with [Legend-Arms] in its traits by an effect, gain 1 memory.
